messages:
ada: Hey team — SCIM sync started failing immediately after yesterday's RBAC/KMS rotation. POST /scim/v2/Users returns 403. App log shows KMS decrypt error referencing key ARN old-arn. Not sure if service role lost kms:Decrypt or if alias swapped.

sam: Can you paste the exact error block?

ada: ```
ERROR scim_sync.sync: decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-key-id
  CausedBy: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/scim-service-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-key-id
  at com.redwood.scim.KMSClient.decrypt(KMSClient.java:87)
  ...
```

leo: We rotated the alias prod/scim -> new-key-id in keyrotation PR #342. If policy pins to ARN it'll break. @ada check scim-service-role's kms resource and any 'kms:ViaService' conditions.

ada: IAM policy currently has "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-key-id" — sigh. Trying to run a manual decrypt:

ada: ```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id alias/prod/scim --region us-west-2
```

idp-bot: deploy:scim-sync v2.1.3 rolled at 2026-03-19T12:22:17Z :package:

oncall-jen: Also seeing SAML assertion mismatch for a few users — idp logs show group attribute as 'groups' empty for jdoe@example.com; might be RBAC mapping change causing duplicate create attempts and 403 as well. Can someone paste an example assertion?

ada: ```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="groups">
  <saml:AttributeValue>engineering,scim-admins</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
<!-- note: some assertions come back with EncryptedID and groups truncated -->
```

marisol: Two separate issues likely: 1) SCIM role pinned to old key ARN after rotation; 2) IdP group mapping changed trimming values. Quick mitigations: rollback alias swap OR update scim-service-role to reference alias/prod/scim (recommended) and add kms:Decrypt permission. For SAML mapping, revert mapping to use 'mail' or 'memberOf' full attribute and re-run backfill.

sam: I can update the IAM policy to use alias/prod/scim and add "kms:Decrypt" and "kms:ListAliases" to the scim-service-role. @oncall-jen can you run dry-run backfill after IAM change?

oncall-jen: Dry-run looks clean. No errors. Scheduling full backfill in 10m and will monitor audit logs for deprov noise. :eyes: 

ada: Backfill completed. SCIM sync succeeded; error rate dropped from 14 failed creates to 0. Confirmed KMS decrypt calls using alias now succeed.

ada: Action items: add runbook checklist for KMS rotation (use alias, update service-role policies, coordinate with idp mapping changes), add CI check to flag policies that pin ARNs. Opening a doc PR.

leo: I'll add a KB entry and link to PR.

ada: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Closing thread. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/scim/2987654321
